sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". This is a nonpersonal services contract requesting software development of Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) interfaces for the Mission Termination System (MTS), yielding a Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL 9) product . MTS is a Run Time Assurance (RTA) tool based on the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) code base created by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (JHU APL). MTS is used at Edwards AFB to safely test autonomous control of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the government. 1.1.1 Description of Services/Objectives. ion. 1.6.3 Delivered product shall integrate A-GRA autonomy interface into the existing MTS Service Set creation tool. Background VocBench is used as the primary curation and editorial interface for NALTerms (NALT) and has been configured to support NAL’s unique, hybrid data model integrating traditional thesaurus concepts with tabular data structures developed under NALT for the Machine Age. The platform enables concept-level editing, bulk editing, and semantic alignment of textual subject indexing and research data attributes. The primary function of the system is semantic curation and workflow support. 2. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations.
